01_whispering_woods.name: 🌲 The Whispering Woods
01_whispering_woods.description: Clear the fog of war by mastering fundamental file system handling and script isolation.

missions.objective: Build a script utilizing built-in Python modules (os, json, time) to log your activity.
Build an absolute minimal SQLite3 database connection and run manual CRUD operations inside a script.
Take your activity logging script, wrap it with a clean Dockerfile, and execute it successfully from inside an isolated container.

02_iron_forge.name: ⚒️ The Iron Forge
02_iron_forge.description: Unlock this forge to learn how components communicate over real networks securely.

missions.objective: Spin up an initial FastAPI server locally with a single endpoint that responds to live inputs.
Connect your backend application container to an independent database service running simultaneously within Docker Compose.
